browser::open.description: Open the browser (it has a profile of its own) and, if `url` is given, go there. Returns the page's element table: every interactive element, each with a short-lived `ref` to act on.

browser::navigate.description: Go to `url`. Returns the new element table.

browser::snapshot.description: Re-read the current page's element table with fresh refs. `with_bbox` adds each element's position.

browser::click.description: Click the element `ref` points at. Pass `expect_name` to be told if the element under that ref is no longer the one you saw.

browser::type.description: Type `text` into the element `ref` points at; `submit` presses Enter afterwards. `expect_name` as for click.

browser::wait_for.description: Wait for a selector to appear, for the network to go idle, or for a number of milliseconds.

browser::screenshot.description: Take a screenshot. Returns a handle to the stored image and its path — never the image itself.

browser::login_passthrough.description: Hand the window to the person, to log in or pass a check. Passwords and passkeys never reach the agent; call `resume` when they are done.

browser::resume.description: Take the browser back after a passthrough.
